newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures end mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures end mostly lower.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mostly lower but largely avoided the ripple effect of a floor wide sell-off sparked by soybeans, pit sources said.
"This market held pretty well with the weakness everywhere else," one floor trader said.
Concerns that a mild monsoon season would lead to a short rice crop in India lent underlying support.
"There's current thinking that the monsoon is going to arrive late and leave early," a trader said.
Indian meteorologists said the monsoon would likely start around June 8, roughly one week late.
Export markets were mostly quiet but there was some cash business in the works with Mexico, one trader said.
Rice ended 6-1/2 cents per cwt lower to two cents higher with July down 6-1/2 at $11.59-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 185 lots.
